offenders.current_behavior: Always returns verdict=EXECUTE regardless of tool permission configuration. Both branches of the conditional return EXECUTE.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Must check ToolPermission.NEVER (block), ToolPermission.ASK (trigger approval callback via AgentLoop._ask_approval), and ToolPermission.ALWAYS (allow). Must consult session-specific tool permissions from agent profile config.

offenders.current_behavior: MCP server never delegates to AgentLoop, GovernanceRuntime, CouncilGate, ToolExecutor, ToolRuntime, TelemetryClient, ReceiptStore, or DirtyGuard. Every governance mechanism is absent at the MCP boundary.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Wire MCP call_tool through the same governance pipeline as AgentLoop: permission check → council consultation → tool execution → evidence envelope emission. Until wired, MCP mutation tools must be cryptographically blocked, not advisory-rejected.

offenders.current_behavior: Mutation tier gate (tier >= 4) checks for string presence of authorization_receipt but performs no cryptographic verification. Any string value passes. No HMAC, Ed25519, nonce/expiry, issuer identity, scope matching, or revocation check.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Tier-4/5 tools must require HMAC-signed, time-bound, scope-bound approval receipts verified server-side. Until cryptographic enforcement exists, tier-4/5 tools must be hard-blocked with no string-bypass path.

offenders.current_behavior: MCPPerUserAuthorization exists in _auth_metadata.py but is never instantiated or checked in server.py. No actor_id, no user_id_hash, no session scoping, no scope enforcement, no expiry check.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Enforce per-user auth with token-gated connection, scoped to session. Per-session authz with scoped tool grants. Expiry-checked. MCP client identity must be registered and auditable.

offenders.current_behavior: A2A server accepts tasks/send commands, creates tasks, and transitions them to SUBMITTED with zero governance checks. No approval gate, no capability gate, no permission validation, no trust tier check.
offenders.recommended_remediation: A2A task submission must go through trust tier validation, attestation verification, and governance gate before any task state transition. Until then, A2A server must not accept tasks/send.

offenders.current_behavior: 13 of 17 MCP tools return hardcoded stub data (no real dispatch). Tool descriptor provenance hash is computed in _auth_metadata.py but never checked at dispatch time.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Wire tools through real governance pipeline. Compute provenance hash at registration time, verify at dispatch time. Reject calls where descriptor hash does not match.

offenders.current_behavior: Server advertises content_light: True but never scans tool responses for sensitive content. No content classification, no redaction, no content_light_classification field.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Integrate redaction.py content-light scanning into MCP response path. Every tool response must carry content_light_classification and provenance hash.

offenders.current_behavior: Tool call results are ad-hoc dicts. No rig.relay.tool.* events emitted. None of the 16 required common-envelope fields appear in any MCP tool response.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Emit evidence envelopes with all required fields for every MCP tool call. Include request_id, session_id, actor_id, surface (mcp), authority_tier, capability_id, input_hash, output_hash, payload_schema, etc.

offenders.current_behavior: IDE sidecar uses a local manifest-derived permission table with independent allow/deny decisions. Does NOT call get_capability_gate(), does NOT consult policy engine, does NOT check cockpit service state. If manifest says default_policy: allow, capability is granted unconditionally.
offenders.recommended_remediation: IDE sidecar must share the same governance spine as ACP and cockpit. Capability permission checks must route through capability gate and policy engine, not static manifest lookup.

offenders.current_behavior: AgentLoop wires to GovernanceRuntime but GovernanceRuntime stub always returns EXECUTE. The entire approval gate chain (ToolRuntime → ToolRuntimePolicy.check() → _permission_decision → should_execute_tool) is inert.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Fix GovernanceRuntime.should_execute_tool (OFF-001). AgentLoop side requires no additional fix once the stub is replaced.

offenders.current_behavior: A2AAgentCard, A2ATaskCard, A2ATaskLifecycleEvent, A2ADelegationReceipt have NO HMAC, signature, or cryptographic attestation fields. Only SHA256 content hashes. No attestation_signature, attestation_key_id, or hmac_proof.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add HMAC-signed attestation fields to all A2A models. Attestation must be verified before any state transition.

offenders.current_behavior: Approval gate is boolean parameter. No HMAC verification, no signed approval receipt check, no approval chain validation. Any caller passing approval_ok=True bypasses the gate.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Replace boolean approval_ok with HMAC-signed approval receipt verification. Check approval chain and scope before allowing mutation.

offenders.current_behavior: Sync JSON-RPC handler supports tools/list, resources/list, prompts/list but is missing tools/call. Any synchronous MCP transport receives Method not found for tool execution.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add tools/call to sync handler. Until added, reject sync transport connections with clear error.

offenders.current_behavior: ConversationRuntime has zero awareness of which protocol surface initiated the turn. All turn state is undifferentiated. Authority tier cannot be enforced per-surface.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Surface-aware ConversationRuntime that carries surface enum in turn context. Authority tier resolved per-surface and enforced before tool dispatch.

offenders.current_behavior: Intent audit writes raw dicts to .build/rig-relay/desktop/intents/intent_events.jsonl. Never creates ReceiptEnvelope objects, never calls ReceiptStore.append(). Intent audit is a parallel non-canonical log disconnected from evidence spine.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Route intent audit events through ReceiptStore. Emit ReceiptEnvelope objects with proper surface classification.

offenders.current_behavior: Policy decisions are pure function returns with no side effects. Never emits receipt events, never creates ReceiptEnvelope, never writes to any store. Decisions exist only in-memory and are discarded.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Emit policy decision as evidence envelope with decision_id. Log the decision to receipt store for audit trail. Gate decisions must carry unique decision_id.

offenders.current_behavior: ACP produces telemetry (session lifecycle, tool call updates) but does NOT produce structured evidence envelopes. No ArtifactEnvelope creation for ACP-originated operations.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Emit evidence envelopes for every ACP edit proposal, permission request, and tool invocation. Receipt-backed audit trail mandatory for ACP.

offenders.current_behavior: BridgeMessage has no authority_tier, policy_decision_id, governance_decision_id, receipt_sha256, evidence_envelope_id, or is_authoritative fields.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add authority-bearing fields to BridgeMessage. Every bridge message should carry surface classification and policy decision reference.

offenders.current_behavior: None of MCPTool, MCPResource, MCPPrompt, or ServerCapabilities include the 16 cross-surface common envelope fields.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add cross-surface authority spine fields to MCP models or wrap tool responses in common evidence envelope before emission.

offenders.current_behavior: Tenant register/grant commands write directly to tenant registry without dry-run default, without approval gate, without governance check.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Tenant admin operations must require operator approval. Registry writes must be gated through governance engine. Dry-run must be default.

offenders.current_behavior: Fleet start-all/stop-all/restart-degraded commands take immediate effect without approval gate, without governance check, without capability gate integration.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Fleet orchestration commands must require operator approval. Fleet state mutations must produce evidence receipts.

offenders.current_behavior: GateDecision model has no decision_id field. Policy decisions cannot be cross-referenced from evidence envelopes, bridge messages, or audit logs.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add decision_id (UUIDv7) to GateDecision. All governance decisions must be uniquely identifiable for cross-referencing.

offenders.current_behavior: ReceiptEnvelope missing authority_tier, trace_id, session_id at top level. ReceiptEvidence has evidence_sha256 but no receipt_sha256 at envelope level.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add authority_tier, trace_id, session_id, and receipt_sha256 to ReceiptEnvelope top-level fields. Align with cross-surface evidence schema spine.

offenders.current_behavior: build_delegation_receipt() exists in _lifecycle.py but is never called by the server. Tasks are created without producing delegation receipts.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Emit delegation receipts for every A2A task submission. Receipt must carry attestation proof.

offenders.symbol: GitHub mutation adapter — no trust spine
offenders.current_behavior: Adapter has 11 ad-hoc gate steps with boolean checks. No canonical GitHub Trust Spine model with tiered trust levels, cryptographic attestation chain, or governance spine integration.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Implement GitHub Trust Spine with tiered trust, cryptographic attestation, and integration with governance engine. Gate check must verify signed approval receipt.

offenders.current_behavior: Intent registries carry description, affects_projection, and parameters but NO authority_tier, requires_receipt, minimum_receipt_kind, or evidence_kind_required metadata.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add authority metadata to intent registries. Every intent must declare its authority tier and minimum evidence requirement.

offenders.current_behavior: Tools use Path.cwd() directly with no workspace root boundary enforcement. No path traversal protection. MCP client can read git state from any directory the server process can access.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Enforce workspace root boundaries. Resolve all paths relative to a configured workspace root. Reject path traversal attempts with refusal envelope.

offenders.current_behavior: Aggregates tool counts but does not produce per-invocation evidence envelopes. No input_hash, output_hash, receipt_id, or artifact_refs per tool call.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Emit per-tool-invocation evidence envelopes from ConversationRuntime or ToolExecutor. Every tool call must produce an evidence receipt.

offenders.current_behavior: bypass_tool_permissions on AgentLoop can suppress the approval callback. ACP governance gating is conditional on agent profile, not hard enforcement at ACP layer.
offenders.recommended_remediation: ACP must enforce permissions at the ACP layer independently of agent profile. Permission bypass should require explicit admin authorization with audit event.

offenders.current_behavior: write_receipt step is defined in _STEPS but implementation just sets entry status to passed. Never calls build_github_operation_receipt() from _receipts.py. Receipt module exists but is unwired.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Wire build_github_operation_receipt() into mutation adapter. Emit evidence envelope for every GitHub mutation operation.

offenders.current_behavior: A2ALocalIdentity.federation_trust_boundary is defined but not enforced. No multi-tier trust model with per-tier gating rules. No trust tier validation at task submission.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Enforce multi-tier trust model: none → local_only → workspace_federation → remote_federation. Task submission gated on trust boundary.

offenders.current_behavior: Projection output includes _release_gate and _schema_validation_errors with underscore-prefix ad-hoc convention. No structural public/private split mechanism. Frontend receives all data.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Structural split: public_sections (safe for any consumer) and private_sections (require authority_tier check). Filtered by authority_tier before emission.

offenders.current_behavior: Preflight script writes JSON to docs/json/governance/ without governance check. Downstream gates may trust this artifact.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Preflight output must be validated before being trusted by downstream gates. Add governance approval for governance-directory writes.

offenders.current_behavior: Projection output includes 30+ fields but none convey authority tier classification. Frontend cannot determine allowed_actions from projection.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add authority context fields to projection: permitted_capabilities, authority_tier, blocked_actions, requires_approval_for list.

offenders.current_behavior: Safety scan exists and runs before publish. But no public/private classification of source artifacts. Internal governance JSON may be published accidentally if registered in site manifest without classification check.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add public_private_classification to site manifest documents. Safety scan must reject documents marked internal_only from static docs publication. Audit current 71 governance documents for internal-only content.

offenders.current_behavior: ReceiptActor has is_authoritative as boolean, not as authority_tier enum. Cannot distinguish read_only vs analysis vs mutation authority levels.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Replace is_authoritative boolean with authority_tier enum. ReceiptActor must carry the full authority tier, not just a binary flag.

offenders.current_behavior: No sampling/createMessage handler exists. No sampling policy configuration point. No capability gate references sampling. No evidence envelope for sampling.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Sampling must be gated by explicit policy. Sampling requests must produce evidence envelopes. Disable sampling until policy exists.

offenders.current_behavior: Entrypoint is a thin router. Only status subcommand calls get_capability_gate(). Default cockpit_main path performs no governance pre-flight.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add pre-flight governance check to CLI entrypoint. Emit surface registration evidence on startup.

offenders.current_behavior: No session-start evidence, no surface registration evidence, no capability manifest evidence emitted by entrypoint.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Emit surface registration evidence on CLI startup. Session lifecycle events should be traceable from CLI origin.

offenders.current_behavior: Refusal envelopes include trace_id, parent_message_id, refusal_code, refusal_reason, but never include governance_decision_id or receipt_sha256.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Add governance_decision_id to bridge refusal envelopes. Link refusals to the governance decision that produced them.

offenders.current_behavior: decide_after_tool_batch returns decision with no mutation-awareness. Runtime treats all tool batches identically. Cannot prevent mutation tool batch dispatch.
offenders.recommended_remediation: ConversationRuntime should detect mutation tools in batch and require explicit mutation approval before returning run_tools decision.

offenders.current_behavior: Tool batch execution yields events but no full evidence envelope per tool call. No rig.relay.tool.call_evidence event defined.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Define and emit rig.relay.tool.call_evidence events per tool invocation from ToolExecutor.

offenders.current_behavior: AgentLoop does not register its surface on init. No surface classification evidence emitted.
offenders.recommended_remediation: AgentLoop should emit surface registration with surface enum and authority tier on init.

offenders.symbol: MCP server — no resource/prompt exposure classification
offenders.current_behavior: MCP resources and prompts are exposed without sensitivity classification. No content_light_classification per resource. No public/private split for resources.
offenders.recommended_remediation: Classify every MCP resource and prompt by sensitivity. Reject exposure of unclassified resources.
